analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported a significant increase in revenue and profitability for the first half of FY27, with revenue reaching Rs. 195 crores and net profit growing to Rs. 6.75 crores. Management highlighted that growth was driven by domestic demand, new premium model launches, and trading activities, despite pressures on margins from rising freight costs and raw material prices. The company targets full-year revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management hopes that the turnover will increase by 30% to 40% more than expected in the next two quarters.
guidance.quote: Yes. And secondly, as you said, in the next two quarters, we hope that the turnover will increase by 30% to 40% more than what we expected.

guidance.claim: Management expects profit to grow by 40% to 50% in any way.
guidance.quote: But our profit will grow by 40%, 50% in any way.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue to be around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore for the financial year.
guidance.quote: According to us revenue is around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore. We hope it should be that.

guidance.claim: Management expects full-year growth to be between 25% and 30%.
guidance.quote: Yes, we hope that 25% to 30% growth will be sustained.

guidance.claim: Revenue for the next quarter is projected to be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth is coming more from the domestic market.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, our growth is coming more from domestic.

demand_outlook.claim: The focus is more on the domestic market now due to increased freight costs in exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, the focus is more on domestic now. Naturally, because now the price has increased a lot in exports. Freight cost has increased a lot. So according to that, we are focusing more on domestic now.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand increased because the company developed a lot of models and expanded its distribution channel.
demand_outlook.quote: It is because of that. And the second thing is that according to domestic, we have developed a lot of models. So according to that, we have got a good response.

demand_outlook.claim: The purchase power of people in tier-2 and tier-3 cities has increased, so the focus is now more on premium customers.
demand_outlook.quote: So our focus now is that even in the tier two, tier three-city, very good clocks are sold. And the purchase power of those people is also increased. So our focus is now more on premium customers.

demand_outlook.claim: The first quarter witnessed strong operational performance and stellar demand across the product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Export demand has faced a slight negative impact due to rising prices.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

demand_outlook.claim: Future revenue depends on the monsoon and conditions in tier-two and tier-three cities.
demand_outlook.quote: It also depends on the monsoon and the situation in tier two and tier three cities.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin stood at 6.7% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.7% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices increased in the market, but the company focused on business growth through special schemes and discounts.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, the raw material prices got increased in the market but we focused more on the business and by giving special schemes and special discount we grew the business.

margins_costs.claim: Imported goods have an average operating margin of 3% to 4%, while trading and manufacturing activities have a 21% gross profit.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, in imported goods, we have an average margin of 3% to 4% and the average margin in trading activity and in manufacturing activity, there is 21% gross profit.

margins_costs.claim: Freight cost increased a lot in exports, impacting export performance and other expenses.
margins_costs.quote: Actually this year freight cost has increased in export. So, according to that export is a little less. There is an effect on export.

margins_costs.claim: Freight cost constitutes 30% to 40% of other expenses.
The EBITDA margin stood at 6.07% in H1 FY27 compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period of the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.07%, compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Margins fluctuate because daily raw material prices increase and decrease.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material is procured in advance for six to seven months.
margins_costs.quote: At the time when the raw material is expected to increase, we purchase raw material for six, seven months.

orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization for now is 52%.

orders_capacity.claim: Current manufacturing capacity utilization is running at 60% to 70%.

capital_allocation.claim: The dividend paid including corporate dividend tax was ₹120.10 lakhs for the period ending 30-09-2026.
There are no current requirements for external borrowing to fund future growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Freight costs have increased significantly in export operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually this year freight cost has increased in export. So, according to that export is a little less. There is an effect on export.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted uncertainty regarding the continuation of the war environment and global situation.
risks_headwinds.quote: See, we do not know till when the war environment will be there. And what will happen. Either of us cannot tell anything, the situation is like that.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that certain statements in the document may be forward-looking in nature and involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and other factors.
risks_headwinds.quote: Certain statements in this document may be forward-looking in nature and involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and other factors which may cause actual results, performance, or achievements of the Company to differ materially from those expressed or implied.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical situations and wars have not had a major impact on operations.
risks_headwinds.quote:
Bhaskar Khandra: Okay, sir. Was there any issue because of geopolitical situation war and all. Is there any effect on operation?
Jayeshbhai Shah: No, there is not that much impact.

management_commitments.claim: Management states that in the coming two to three months the company will launch eight to ten new models.
management_commitments.quote: And we have launched a lot of new models in these two months. And in the coming two, three months we will launch eight to ten new models.

management_commitments.claim: The plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and achieve a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore with an EPS of Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.
management_commitments.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6. It becomes Rs. 6.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to sell clocks in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items.
management_commitments.quote: And going forward, actually we believe in value and not in volume. So, slowly, wall clock earlier wrist watches we used to sell in the range of Rs. 200, Rs. 500, Rs. 700, Rs. 1000. Today, wrist watch is sold for Rs. 5,000, Rs. 50,000 and even Rs. 1 lakh. So, our clock is sold according to interior of the house. So, if people buy house for Rs. 1 crore, Rs. 2 crores they put up clocks worth Rs. 1,000, Rs. 5,000, Rs. 10,000 and Rs. 15,000. So, going forward our plan is to make value products.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
